figures.finding: Film professionals in Sri Lanka, actors among them, are recognised by an NFC film-industry identity card (application and conditions from the NFC); the NFC Trust for Film Artistes and Technicians (Act No. 3 of 1986) pays a monthly pension of Rs 5,000 to 189 qualified artistes and technicians aged 60 and over. No actors' union agreement or rate was found.
figures.applies: Sri Lanka, film artistes and technicians; read 2026-11-01.

sources.said: Identities are issued by the NFC for recognition of film professionals in Sri Lanka and the application for the Identity, along with the conditions, could be obtained from the NFC.

The National Film Corporation Trust Fund for Film Artistes and Technicians was established under Parliament Act No. 3 of 1986 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. … Currently, the pension scheme supports 189 qualified film artistes and technical professionals aged 60 years and above. Each eligible recipient receives a monthly pension of Rs. 5,000/-

figures.finding: The National Film Corporation, the state film body, sits in Colombo; no source gives a share of production by city.

value.basis: seat of the National Film Corporation

figures.finding: Sinhala and Tamil are the official and national languages of Sri Lanka, English the link language, by the constitution; no source gives the language of screen work beyond it.

sources.said: The Official Language of Sri Lanka shall be Sinhala. Tamil shall also be an official language. English shall be the link language. … The National Languages of Sri Lanka shall be Sinhala and Tamil.
